svg.title: TooManyLags Server Side: grid coverage and transition delays
svg.desc: Four north-facing examples using production grid masks. Normal: nine immediate red cells plus three orange cells with 0.2 seconds delay. Fast movement: the same twelve cells are immediate. Poor connection: sixteen immediate red cells plus three orange cells. Poor connection and fast movement: all nineteen cells are immediate. White cells make no player-grid request. Yellow outer cells are disabled by default. Green marks the player and character heading.
svg.text: Default directional settings. Poor connections expand the grid; fast movement removes the forward wait.
Character facing: up / 4 x 4 m per cell
Forward row becomes immediate at 4 m/s
Character facing: up / 4 x 4 m per cell
Larger grid starts at 200 ms ping
Character facing: up / 4 x 4 m per cell
Expanded grid; forward row is red.
Character facing: up / 4 x 4 m per cell
Thresholds and delays are configurable. White cells are not requested by the player grid; this does not mean unloaded.
Cardinal direction shown. Diagonal large grids use 20 red + 3 forward cells. Loading and active-use guards still apply.
